The '''A-6 Interceptor''' was a nimble short-range [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was equipped with triple [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

A-6 Interceptors were used in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. In the [[First Battle of Qotile]], they were part of the fleet of [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] A-6 interceptor<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], including [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red]] and [[Blue Squadron (Jedi Order)|Blue Squadrons]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], launched from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Captor-class heavy munitions cruiser|freighters]] in the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile|final battle of the conflict]].<ref name="Star Wars 39" />

It was the predecessor of the [[A-7 Hunter Interceptor|A-7 Hunter interceptor]] and eventual [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic-affiliated starfighter that appeared in the [[2001]] comic arc [[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War|''Republic: The Stark Hyperspace War'']] was [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]ed by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' as being the A-6 Interceptor from the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']] novel.<ref name="Endnotes PT4">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/21728447315/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-4|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 4}}</ref>
